title: The Bad Cot Leg
lines: Ben has a cot. He naps on it.
But a cot leg is bad.
The cot tips! Ben hits the rug.
Ben is mad. He is not sad.
Ben gets a big fat log.
Ben cuts the log a lot.
He sets it up as a cot leg.
Ben sits. The cot did not tip!
Ben lets his cat nap on it.

questions.ask: What did Ben use to fix the cot?
questions.listenFor: A log that he cut. It is said in the story. Have your child point to the line that tells you, then read it out loud again.

questions.ask: How do you know the fix worked?
questions.listenFor: The cot did not tip when Ben sat on it. Listen for the sitting-and-not-tipping part, not just "it worked."

questions.ask: Do you think Ben is good at fixing things? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer here. You want a reason pulled from the story - he cut the log himself, or the cot held him up. A reason beats a yes or no.
